parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the WAF rule. To obtain the rule ID, call the [ListWafRules](~~2878257~~) operation.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: The position of the rule within the rule set.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The ID of the site. To obtain the site ID, call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, use this parameter to specify the effective configuration version. The default is version 0.
